description: Get your personalized daily lead recommendations based on your targeting preferences. Returns AI-scored companies that match your ideal customer profile. A new list is built every day, weekends included, and each day's list stands alone (Monday's list does not repeat Saturday's or Sunday's). To catch up on days you missed, pass days (e.g. days: 3 on a Monday returns Saturday, Sunday and Monday).

days.description: How many days of daily lists to return, counting today (1 = today only, the default; 3 on a Monday = the weekend plus today; max 7).

name: get_daily_leads
title: Get daily leads
